method: Fresh primary-source verification of every used reference, bibliographic field and associated literature claim. Historical bibliography not copied. Direct sources read through web tools and independently retrieved with validated TLS curl; immutable retrieval hashes are receipts, not promises that changing documentation remains byte-identical. No absence-of-prior-work or first-system claim.

references.claim: LangGraph node caching derives its default key from node input; cache key and TTL are configurable.
references.basis: Official Graph API documentation, Node caching section; no universal functionality assumption attributed to LangGraph.

references.claim: Nondeterministic operations including LLM invocations belong in Activities outside the workflow replay path.
references.basis: Official Workflow Definition, Deterministic constraints; durable replay is distinguished from changed-request reuse.

references.claim: VisTrails assumes cacheable modules return the same outputs for the same inputs and permits nondeterministic modules to be marked non-cacheable.
references.basis: Author-written chapter, Section 23.3.2. Original publication date is not stated on the consulted page; bibliography uses n.d. rather than inventing a date.

references.claim: GPTCache performs semantic response caching and evaluates incorrect hits, discussing false-positive tradeoffs.
references.basis: Original ACL Anthology paper, Sections3.5,4,5 and tables1–2; no claim that semantic caches ignore false positives.

references.claim: Mnimi addresses statistical independence constraints for cached samples in probabilistic LLM workflows.
references.basis: Original author-posted arXiv v1 abstract; not presented as peer-reviewed or compared experimentally.

references.claim: StepCache uses task-aware verification and selective regeneration of reusable output steps.
references.basis: Original author-posted arXiv v1 abstract; performance numbers are not imported and no peer-review status is asserted.

references.claim: Current provider documentation says temperature has no effect in thinking mode.
references.basis: Official Thinking Mode, Input and Output Parameters. The historical sweep settings are separately established by frozen call specifications; current docs do not fix a historical model snapshot.

scope_note: Only references used by the new publication versions are audited. Historical drafts and unused historical bibliography entries remain preserved, with no validation implied.
